source.note: Conditions, citations and plain-language effects only; no Fastwork code. Lines are 1-based in the prettified snapshot.

conditions.effect: Reduced motion: animations/transitions off or final states, and layout changes too (hero track height, sticky off via the no-preference twins, smooth scroll off).

uses.effect: Extra pain notes and every commission animation static (underline, fee avatars/messages, typing caret, why-bring).
Hero track height changes (layout), no scatter/blur, cards/copy/CTA static.
People transitions off; people-o expanded state static.
Profile phone and reviews track static.
Morph pill/panel/nav morph and column track: no transitions/blur.
RSVP button border transition off (inline style block).
Why-bring close delay 0 instead of 480 ms.
Runway spacer only when not reduced (and not C1000).
Svelte MediaQuery store: digit spring skipped.
Reveal: expanded state and faces at once (else staged 1300 ms + 120 ms); reset when the heading leaves the 0.35 IntersectionObserver threshold.
Future shrink becomes a step at 0.5.
Final state; glint SVG animate loop off.
Platform shrink becomes a step at 0.5.
OR (width<=600): hero chrome ready at once.

conditions.effect: Motion allowed: entrance animations, pain sticky, drawer slide-in, title sweep, nav sheen.
sb-button hover tint only on hover-capable input.
UI-kit tooltip keeps itself open on pointer-leave on hover-less input; no tooltip is used on this page (INFERRED inert).

uses.effect: Tooltip: no hide on pointer-leave (INFERRED unused on this page).

conditions.effect: Flips the light/dark toggles on the root; neutralised by html data-theme=light and the later light rule (0:258). Page must stay light (INFERRED no visible effect).

uses.effect: Light/dark toggles flipped; neutralised (0:258, html data-theme=light; portals copy data-theme UI:883).

conditions.effect: Countdown smallest size.
Community pill stacks; proof text wraps.
Profile review summary restacks.
Phone hero (mobile deck replaces orbit), CTA stack one column, accent box, signup padding; JS: ring splash skipped/finished and nav chrome ready at once (each OR reduced motion).

uses.effect: Orbit hidden, mobile deck shown, copy repositioned, title sizes, cue placement.
CTA stacks one column, RSVP first (legacy max-width syntax, inline style after the linked sheets).
OR reduced motion: skip ring splash at load/bfcache; change listener finishes it when it starts to match; widening never restarts it.
OR reduced motion: is-hero-chrome-ready at once, else after 1140 ms or splash done; change listeners.

conditions.effect: Hero scroll-cue entrance and nav hero-pill fade-in only above 600.

uses.effect: Cue blur/copy-from-ring entrance; rest transform after splash.
Hero pill hidden until chrome ready, then fades in.

conditions.effect: Orbit edge push variable (continuous in vw inside the band).
Orbit stage full width; side cards pushed in by the edge push.

uses.effect: Stage full width; side cards pushed in.

conditions.effect: Phone geometry: commission titles, why-bring full-width sheet, profile deck bleed, platform single column, morph pill/panel vars, nav geometry, compact language switch.

uses.effect: Commission titles; why-bring full-width bottom sheet (safe-area padding at 2:1159).
Platform features/rows; morph pill/panel geometry vars; columns 4+ hidden.
Nav phone geometry (pill/panel vars, top, inset, logo scale, button sizes).

conditions.effect: Nav translucent white background.
Commission tablet band: rows as a 2-column grid.
Platform section padding/radius/tools grid; morph footer stacks.

uses.effect: Section padding, shrink radius, card, title, pain underlay vars, tools grid.

conditions.effect: Pure-width phone path: why-bring drawer, pain layout + notes hidden, people card/o/carousel, signup shell, platform checks hidden; JS: seller preview off, pain note layout set, pain-dark rule, (inert) sheet store.

uses.effect: Pain phone layout; notes hidden (JS twin N2:4415).
Future card layout, people-o face size, community pill.
Dialog bar/action footer re-grid, sticky footer (safe-area padding at 2:4100).
Base note layout: mobile set centred on an 860 design, desktop set on 1440x868; change listener + ResizeObserver.
NOT matching and not reduced: 3 s extra-note ticker (max 12); see js.pain-container-1100.
Seller preview (hover/focus/click) disabled; read per event.
Reactive store for a sheet presentation; the only caller passes dialog (N2:13306), so inert but created.
Above 860 pain always dark; at <=860 only once the showcase top <= 0.5 px; change listener.

conditions.effect: Desktop profile showcase (inactive shells hidden) and desktop platform row titles; JS: one arm of the desktop deck gate.

uses.effect: Inactive profile shells display:none (2:3267). At touch 861-1200 / landscape device-width<=500 this overlaps mq.c860; 2:3267 (0,2,0) beats 2:3468 (0,1,0) display:flex regardless of order, so inactive shells stay hidden there (INFERRED visible outcome; measure 1024t, 932x430).
Desktop per-row title layout and sweep variant; later than 2:5672 so wins on shared props in the overlap.

Desktop deck = (min-width: 861px) AND NOT c860 AND NOT reduced: section height deck + 1.45vh + (n-1) x 0.34vh, --profile-scale eases from min(1.22, (innerWidth-112)/(deckWidth-248)) to 1; polled per frame.

conditions.effect: Nested block: profile sticky, chrome and tabs desktop geometry.

uses.effect: Profile sticky, chrome, tabs desktop geometry (nested in 2:3248).

conditions.effect: Platform card/mission spacing band.
Platform header/features/rows tablet layout.
Platform row copy and row-title type; morph title size.
Platform mission title size.
Desktop sticky commission.

uses.effect: Sticky commission (min-height 100vh+48, top -48). Overlaps mq.c1000 at touch 1001-1200 and landscape device-width<=500.

conditions.effect: Platform tools grid columns.
Profile rail, posts grid and reviews gap (plain width, no touch clause: a separate desktop band 1031-1200).

Combo 860 (phone OR small device OR touch tablet to 1200): all shrink vars neutralised, profile deck becomes a snap rail, platform phone titles/sweep, nav+morph panel = viewport minus 40; JS: compact deck mode, note drag off.

uses.effect: Shrink vars reset, profile sticky off, tabs horizontal drag rail, deck x-mandatory snap; all shells shown only where (width>=861px) is false (see 2:3248).
Mission/row titles stacked; 28px sweep variant (loses to 2:5818 in the overlap).
All shrink vars neutralised; platform card/stage/artboard resized; nav+morph panel = 100dvh-40 x 100vw-40.
Note drag disabled (keys still move notes).
Compact deck: horizontal tabs, drag rail (4 px slop), snap tracking (150 ms + scrollend), active +-1 shells rendered; change listener.

conditions.effect: Combo 1000: commission phone/tablet layout; JS: compact class, compact arrow, runway spacer and title-wrap detection (polled per frame, no change listener).

uses.effect: Phone/tablet commission: sticky off, single column, compact copy, fee visual scale, why-link.
Compact class + arrow; runway 0.06 x innerHeight only when not compact and not reduced; title-wrap detection only when compact; polled per scroll/resize frame, no change listener.

equivalentForms: three matchMedia calls OR-ed: (max-width: 1000px) | (max-device-width: 500px) | (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse) and (max-width: 1200px)

conditions.effect: Combo 1030: every profile widget compact (about, posts, reviews, gallery, feed).

uses.effect: Widgets compact (crumb/claim hidden, cover, identity, avatar, stats).

conditions.effect: Countdown medium size. The only combo WITHOUT the device-width arm; differs from mq.c1000 only for fine pointer + device-width<=500 + width>1000 (INFERRED no real device).

uses.effect: Countdown medium size (font 28, cell 36 per v1).

conditions.condition: root min-width 320px (below it the page stops shrinking and scrolls sideways)
conditions.effect: Hard lower bound of every width band.

conditions.condition: viewport meta width=device-width, initial-scale=1; no viewport-fit=cover
conditions.effect: Every width query depends on it (without it iOS lays out at 980). Ship the identical meta. Without viewport-fit=cover iOS safe-area insets are 0 (INFERRED).
Sheet/footer/signup bottom padding; same fallbacks (0px twice, max(24px, inset) once).

conditions.condition: 16 plain :hover rules not gated by (hover: hover)
conditions.effect: Sticky hover after a tap on touch; the rewrite must NOT add hover gates the original lacks.

conditions.condition: hero stage clientWidth (fallback innerWidth) < 1280, splash expanding phase only
conditions.effect: Splash cards pulled in by (1280 - stage) x 0.35 px; design canvas 1512x779. Stage = viewport width at 601-1511 (INFERRED from 2:2009).

conditions.condition: pain-notes container width < 1100 (only when not (width<=860px) and not reduced)
conditions.effect: Extra-note placement: jittered slots below 1100, 120 scored random samples at or above; extras cleared when the commission card top < 0.995vh. Viewport width at which the container hits 1100 to be MEASURED.
Continuous scale below a 345.6 px parent; live.

conditions.condition: digit spacer offsetHeight via ResizeObserver (follows CSS font at 400 / 1000-or-touch-1200)
conditions.effect: Face translateY = slot x measured cell height (v1: 31/36/52); faces hidden until height > 0; live on resize.

conditions.condition: preview width min(320, innerWidth-24), 12 px from edges, flip above if past innerHeight-12; re-run on every scroll/resize frame
conditions.effect: Knee at innerWidth 344; live recomputation via the scene engine subscription.

conditions.condition: IntersectionObserver threshold 0.35 on the future heading
conditions.effect: Reveal staged when visible, reset when it leaves.

conditions.condition: computed position of the profile sticky == sticky (true only under mq.w-ge-861-nopref and not mq.c860)
conditions.effect: Nav scroll-hidden / profile-sticky-hidden while pinned; per scroll frame.

conditions.condition: elementFromPoint at the nav centre against section selectors
conditions.effect: is-on-dark over pain/platform/shrinking commission; per scroll frame.

conditions.condition: platform rect height >= 0.45 x (visualViewport.height or innerHeight) and bottom <= that + 8; IO rootMargin 200%
conditions.effect: Arms wheel/touch scroll-jack for the 680 ms morph tween; reduced motion jumps. No width gate.

conditions.condition: card top in [0.06, 0.42] x innerHeight; bottom in [0.35, 0.85] x innerHeight; reduced = step at 0.5
conditions.effect: Enter-shrink / shrink vars; no width gate.
--future-shrink; no width gate in JS (CSS mq.c860 neutralises it).

conditions.condition: scene active if rect within [-innerHeight, 2 x innerHeight]; IO rootMargin 100% (pain 150%)
conditions.effect: data scene active/paused; deferred rendering with measured intrinsic size; one rAF for scroll+resize.

conditions.condition: unit vector from viewport centre to the focused trigger (16 px scale), at open
conditions.effect: --dialog-dir-x/y entrance direction; fallback 0/16 px.

conditions.condition: width min(360px, 100vw - 48px); maxHeight 85vh (props, not media queries)
conditions.effect: 360 px at viewport >= 408, 100vw-48 below.

conditions.condition: link preload on mousemove (20 ms debounce) vs mousedown/touchstart
conditions.effect: Network only, no visual effect; match or exclude on purpose.
Svelte runtime template import path; no visual effect; not a breakpoint (listed for completeness).

overlaps.region: touch (hover:none, pointer:coarse) at 861-1200, or device-width<=500 with width>=861 (phone landscape 932x430)
overlaps.outcome: Both match. People: 2:3384 later wins on sticky/position, but 2:3267 (0,2,0) beats 2:3468 (0,1,0) so inactive shells stay display:none. Platform: 2:5818 is later than 2:5672 and wins; 2:10990 single-class selectors lose to 2:5818's multi-class ones (INFERRED).
overlaps.status: CONFIRMED syntax; visible outcome INFERRED (measure at 1024t and 932x430)

overlaps.region: touch at 1001-1200, or device-width<=500 with width>=1001
overlaps.outcome: Both match on commission; source order and specificity decide.
Commission compact and platform desktop mission title both apply.
JS resolves it: desktop deck requires NOT c860, so touch tablets get the compact JS deck while CSS still hides inactive shells.

Pure-width users (people.o preview, pain layout, pain notes hidden, pain-dark, sheet store) take the DESKTOP path while combo users (deck, note drag, shrinks) take the compact path. Never substitute one for the other.

fractionalGaps.note: (width>600px) matches in the gap; 2:2009/2:2026 do not.
CSS and JS ((max-width: 860px) vs (min-width: 861px)) both leave it unmatched.

continuous.expression: orbit unit 100cqw / 302 on an inline-size container
secure-network arm sizes from cqw/cqh (size container)
viewport units: vw 34, vh 15, svh 9, dvh 7 uses; 16 clamp() calls

absent: @container queries (containers exist only for cq units)

profiles.at: every edge pair (reduced motion changes layout)

special.why: device-width<=500 arm with width>860/1000: both overlap pairs (mq.c860 + mq.w-ge-861, mq.c1000 + mq.w-ge-1001)
device-width 500/501 alone flips mq.c860/c1000/c1030 but NOT mq.c1000-nodw (the one combo without the arm)
the combos need hover:none AND pointer:coarse; each alone must not match; (hover: hover) and (hover: none) checked separately
mq.dark must stay neutralised: pixels equal to light

special.via: DPR 1.25 / browser zoom so innerWidth is fractional
special.why: the original leaves (N, N+1) unmatched by both sides; the rewrite must too
profile shell clamp knees at viewport height 823/900; iOS toolbar heights; vh-band JS gates

dpr.for: touch at or below 500 px, phone-landscape
fractional-gaps probes on a phone width (412)

matrix.dprNote: No DPR-dependent code: no devicePixelRatio, no resolution queries, every srcset has one URL (CONFIRMED by grep). DPR changes raster only, plus fractional CSS widths.

jsEdges.why: change listeners (splash finish is one-way; chrome ready)
w860 listeners (pain layout, pain-dark), c860 deck listener, ResizeObserver on notes
commission compact polled per frame, no listener
splash stage pull, only during the splash

sequences.note: original non-deterministic (pain IO after reflow): accept either A/A class

liveMediaFlips.note: commission c1000 is polled with no change listener: updates at the next scroll/resize frame (INFERRED); the rewrite must match

liveResize.compare: rewrite after sequence vs original after the SAME sequence (not vs a fresh load): some original state is path-dependent

estimate.plus: one Simulator check (430x775 DPR 3) and the live-resize sequences
